subject.title: fix(preflight): accept structured proof evidence safely

question: Should external merge preflight start accepting this exact structured proof and dependency-guard-clearance comment shape as non-blocking evidence?
rationale: The code path controls whether automated external merge preflight treats GitHub comments as blockers, so green CI does not fully settle the operational risk of the new allow-list.

options.title: Accept the narrow allow-list
options.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms these exact structured proof and guard-clearance templates are the intended automation contract.

options.title: Ask for broader fixtures first
options.body: Hold the draft until additional real preflight artifacts demonstrate the parser handles the proof styles maintainers want to support.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow allow-list
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms these exact structured proof and guard-clearance templates are the intended automation contract.
